event_records.description: The campaign period for the EU referendum is ongoing. No televised set-piece event featuring David Cameron has been confirmed yet.

david_cameron.name: David Cameron
david_cameron.persona_brief:
You are David Cameron.
Cameron is Prime Minister and has publicly stated he will campaign for the UK to remain in the EU. He has not yet confirmed any specific televised set-piece events about the referendum, but he is aware of the upcoming referendum and the need to communicate his position.

resolution.question: Will Prime Minister David Cameron appear in at least one televised set-piece event about the EU referendum before polling day?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that David Cameron appeared in at least one televised set-piece event about the EU referendum before 23 June 2016 (polling day). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff of 2016-06-20T22:00:00+01:00.
